item.text: The current component calls `start` directly and always opens the device menu when the microphone line is activated. I’m checking the header and menu contracts now so the fix preserves their existing interaction conventions while adding synchronous duplicate guards.

The existing menu already supplies actual `MediaDeviceInfo` objects, and the audio selection hook updates its label after `setDevice`. I’ll add a synchronous ref guard for initiation (so same-render rapid events are blocked), keep React state in sync for the rendered disabled state, and guard menu opening while it is visible. The close callback will be wrapped to retain its current one-call behavior.
